topic: Getting paid from US clients in Pakistan
caption:
Client ne payment bhej di. Aap tak kaise aayegi?

Ek freelancer ne kaam pura kiya, par payment ka rasta pehle se nahi dekha.

Yeh teen cheezein pehle dekho:
1. Payoneer account banao. Yeh aapko US bank details deta hai.
2. Local bank mein payout aam taur par ek se teen working days leta hai.
3. Wise Pakistan mein abhi open nahi hai, toh uspar plan mat banao.

Guide chahiye? Comment "PAYMENT" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain, platform par ek baar check kar lein.

3. Har baat likhit mein confirm karo, deadline bhi.

3. Roz paanch sahi logon ko connect karo, chhote note ke saath.

dm:

Ek email, ek hi ask. Aur wahi likho jo sach ho.

topic: Upwork Connects: do not waste them
caption:
Upwork par har proposal ka paisa lagta hai.

Ek freelancer ne bina dekhe pachaas jobs par apply kiya. Connects khatam, aur kaam ek bhi nahi.

Yeh teen cheezein check karo:
1. Job fresh ho, taaki aap pehle proposals mein rahein.
2. Client ki payment verified ho, aur hiring history dekho.
3. Job post poori padho, aur usi ke hisaab se likho.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "UPWORK" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain, platform par ek baar check kar lein.

Example scenario: yeh ek misaal hai, real client nahi.

Upwork par apply karne se pehle check karo:
1. Job fresh hai (kuch ghante purani).
2. Client ki payment verified hai.
3. Client ki hiring history aur reviews dekho.
4. Job post poori padho, aur proposal ki pehli line usi par likho.

Upwork ke mutabiq ek Connect 15 cents ka hota hai, aur fees badalti rehti hain. Upwork ka current fee page dekh lein.

2. Revisions ki limit rakho, jaise do rounds.
3. Shuru karne se pehle aadha advance lo.

Checklist chahiye? Comment "SCOPE" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

- 15 min: 5 messages ya proposals.
- 10 min: profile ya portfolio mein ek chhota sudhaar.

Hafte ke end mein dekho: kitne bheje, kitne reply, kya sikha. Agle hafte ek cheez badlo.
